reviews_h2: Straight from the people who called us

reviews.author: Jeff Hatley
reviews.text: Had a well pump emergency at my senior mom's home this past weekend. I called Plumbing Agents because they were close by. I'm so glad I called them now. The young lady on the phone was very pleasant. The crew arrived and completed the repairs much sooner than I expected. The price was better than I expected also. Mom said the guys were as nice as they could be. Good to see that there's still some good, respectable craftsmen out there. Thank you so much Plumbing Agents. I've already referred you to a friend. (Update) A year later and my mom desperately needed new inlet valves installed on her washer. I was afraid she would have to wait because it was unusually cold and I was sure everyone would be busy with bursting pipes and such. Once again, the Plumbing Agents came through. Prompt, skilled and courteous. I highly recommend them. Thank you!!

reviews.author: Heather Troxler
reviews.text: I wanted to give a good review, but I can't. Nelson gave me his number to call for a estimate appointment which was great. Another nice guy came a few weeks later to do the estimate said they would get back with an estimate ,but never did. I called a few weeks later and left a few messages and they won't even return a simple phone call. That's not right. It's not good for business and it's not professional.

reviews.author: Marla Germanson
reviews.text: Called this company to inspect my water heater and some fittings that were under the house for due diligence. They were very prompt and did an excellent job on both requests! Will definitely use them again!

reviews.author: Margaruite rains
reviews.text: Service call on water heater not working. On time appointment and very pleasant knowledgeable gentlemen quickly assess and recommended The best solution.. quickly sent estimate and looking forward to doing business with Plumbing Agents.

reviews.author: Hazel Mynes
reviews.text: Plumbing Agents is who I call when I need a plumber! They are quick, do excellent work, and will always charge fairly for their services. I really like the yearly maintenance plan they offer, too!

reviews.author: Ronald Miller
reviews.text: Texted them at midnight once I found out my natural gas water heater was leaking badly! Surprised they texted back immediately. Thought it would be a slow process, but they came out to my house 8am the next morning.....gave me a price I could live with and had the job done by 4 that same day. EXCELLENT SERVICE

reviews.author: Humam Bianouni
reviews.text: We used Nelson and Shane when we built our home and they did all the plumbing..very pleased with their work!!! Great honest folks with quality work.

reviews.author: Mike Andrews
reviews.text: I grew up with Nelson. He will do a good job. He has always helped me when I called. He is a true friend and I would recommend him.

reviews.author: Barnes McClamrock
reviews.text: Had a water line burst in my crawl space. The gentleman (Kay - I might have spelled his name wrong..) who addressed the issue along with Austin was intelligent and hard working. I will definitely give these guys a call in the future if needed!

reviews.author: Brenda Cline
reviews.text: I have worked with Nelson for many years. He does a fantastic job. Just the best ! I refer him to all my buyers and sellers!

reviews.author: Marie “MarieM37” Maurer
reviews.text: Nelson and his crew are amazing. They are fast to respond. They answer all questions and have the utmost patience. I will hire them 1000 times over again. Thank you!!

reviews.author: Lee Eury
reviews.text: Can't recommend these guys enough. They came out on a Saturday at the last minute and did a great job. I will definitely use them again!!
